history.summary: Sri Durga Mandir on Chandmari Road (New Chandmari), Motihari, is the most-documented 'Durga Mandir' in the town (Justdial 4.4/244, Top-Rated.Online 4.4/236). No founding date, dynasty, or founder is documented in any source consulted; it appears to be a local neighbourhood shrine popular with devotees, situated by the national highway. Other same-named shrines exist in the Motihari area (Balua Chowk, Ram Nagar, Devapur), so the CSV's generic 'Durga Mandir' is matched to this listing with that ambiguity flagged.

name: Sri Durga Mandir
town_description: Motihari is the headquarters of East Champaran district in northern Bihar. The town is best known as the birthplace of writer George Orwell (1903) and sits on the East-West Corridor (NH-27) near the Nepal border.

travel.airport: Darbhanga Airport (~140 km) or Patna (~170 km); distances approximate
travel.railway: Bapudham Motihari station, on the Barauni-Gorakhpur line, in the town
travel.road: NH-27 (East-West Corridor) passes through Motihari; local auto-rickshaws and taxis in town

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Navratri and Durga Puja are the busiest periods
